title: build continuous toolcall-regression-detector tied to model/config diffs
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Problem: Model or runtime config changes (kernel selection, kv-cache strategy, quantization profile, prompt templating) occasionally alter which tool a model chooses or the shape/validity of tool args. We need an automated, continuous eval harness that detects regressions in tool selection accuracy and argument validation when any config/model change lands, and that gates canary/full rollouts until critical regressions are triaged.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic CI job is added that runs the toolcall-regression-detector on every model snapshot or config PR affecting routing/serving settings
The detector computes selection-accuracy, top-3 selection coverage, argument-schema-violation-rate, and downstream-success-rate for a representative prompt corpus
Regression thresholds are configurable per project and per model group; default thresholds: selection accuracy drop > 3% OR arg-schema-violation increase > 1% triggers a failure
A Slack alert and a PagerDuty incident (for P0 projects) are created when a regression is detected; the alert links to failing eval cases, diffs, and a reproducible run command
The CI job produces an artifacts bundle (failing prompts, model responses, parsed tool calls, normalized arg diff) stored in S3 and linked from the Linear ticket and the rollout UI
The detector integrates with existing rollout gating so canary traffic is paused for failing releases until a patch or manual override with documented risk acceptance is recorded
technical_notes: Harness will reuse the invocation-eval runner but extend it with: model/config diff input, per-case golden tool selection+args, and a configurable comparator that tolerates non-deterministic tokenization artifacts
We will instrument a lightweight parser that normalizes tool calls (case folding, UUID masking, timestamp removal) to reduce false positives
Evaluation corpus: 12k prompts stratified across chat/system/prompt-length/intent buckets. Start with 2k critical production prompts from customer opt-in sets for initial runs
Performance: runs should complete within 45 minutes on a dedicated 8-GPU CI pool using batching and prefix caching; plans to add a low-cost sampling mode for quick prechecks
Comparator outputs: per-case verdict (PASS | SELECT_MISMATCH | ARGS_INVALID | PARSE_FAIL), confidence scores, and token-level diff when applicable
We will store historic baselines keyed by (model_version, config_hash) to enable trend analysis over time
Security: ingestion of customer prompts must respect PII policies; we will only store hashed or redacted prompts for customer data and require opt-in for raw traces
test_plan: Unit tests for normalization/parsing boundary cases (embedded JSON, nested function calls, escaped characters)
Smoke: run detector against current prod model (baseline) and a synthetic change that flips tool selection for 1% of cases to validate alerting
Canary simulation: run detector on 'toy' canary rollout pipeline to ensure gating integration pauses rollout on failure
False-positive analysis: manual review of 200 sampled fails to tune masking rules and comparator thresholds
End-to-end: merge gating PR, deploy to staging, and exercise via full run with the 12k corpus, verify artifacts upload and Slack/PagerDuty notifications
metrics: selection_accuracy: percent of prompts where primary predicted tool matches golden tool
top_3_coverage: percent where golden tool is in top-3 ranked predictions
arg_schema_violation_rate: percent of parses that fail schema validation against registered tool specs
downstream_success_rate: percent of end-to-end tasks completed successfully when simulated tool outputs are applied
flaky_parse_rate: percent of tool calls the parser could not confidently normalize
time_to_detection: wall clock time between PR merge and first failing eval run
dashboards: Evals -> Toolcall Regression Overview (selection_accuracy, arg_violation over time, per-model series)
Per-model diffs: last 10 diffs for model_version vs baseline with sample failing prompts
Alerting: recent incidents and reason (selection mismatch vs arg violation) with links to artifacts
dependencies: ENG-37210: invocation-eval-runner-refactor (rebase and API to accept config diffs)
ENG-38940: argparse-schema-service (canonical tool arg schema registry)
DEVOPS-211: CI GPU pool for nightly/PR eval runs
SEC-88: PII redaction policy and storage encryption for eval artifacts

Refine comparator tolerances after FP study and reduce flaky_parse_rate target to <0.5%
